output_how: Registered function groups return named outputs (active_users, csv, data, event_id, events, events_per_minute, metrics, pageviews…) via the module's routes/services.
output_why: Serves the Analytics functions declared in its FunctionGroupContracts.
process_description: CANONICAL track a custom event. Accepts event type, properties, and user context. Used by the frontend for event tracking. CANONICAL track a page view. Records the page URL, referrer, and user context. Used by the frontend for pageview tracking. CANONICAL track a document upload event. Records the document ID, type, and upload context. Called after successful upload. CANONICAL aggregated metrics for a time period. Returns event counts, pageview counts, and document upload counts. Admin-only. Used by the analytics dashboard. CANONICAL realtime metrics. Returns current active users, events in the last minute, and pageviews in the last minute. Admin-only. CANONICAL metrics for a specific user. Returns event count, pageview count, and document upload count for the user over a given time range. Admin-only. CANONICAL list of recent events. Supports filtering by event type and limit. Admin-only. Used by the analytics events viewer. CANONICAL export analytics data as JSON. Returns events and metrics for the given time range. Admin-only. CANONICAL export analytics data as CSV. Returns events and metrics for the given time range in CSV format. Admin-only. CANONICAL analytics statistics summary. Returns total events, total users, total pageviews, and total uploads. Admin-only. CANONICAL analytics dashboard summary. Returns aggregated metrics, recent events, and top pages. Admin-only. Used by the admin analytics dashboard page.
process_context: Derived record. Invoked via the analytics module's registered routes and dependencies.
